body: Synthesized 12 real-time founder fragments into a coherent NORTHSTAR document (EMILY/docs/NORTHSTAR_PROMPT_O_VERSE.md, golden-indexed PROMPT-O-VERSE-NORTH): the 'categorize all information' mission reframe, the founder's own sharpest insight (a 'reverse labeled dataset' -- the taxonomy is the durable asset, generated images are cheap tagged exemplars, not the dataset itself), the three-stage discovery mechanism (label -> generate -> label the generated data, which is how the per-category feature-value space gets discovered), two taxonomy branches (historical/stylistic vs surreal/whimsical), two-tier prompting refined to a feature-value space per category rather than one fixed expanded prompt, the gallery correctly framed as the affordance not a bolt-on, a flagged-not-forced NORN architectural fit, and a brainstormed adjacent-uses section. Named what's deliberately undecided (image-gen backend, repo home, second domain, moderation) rather than guessing. Every fragment logged via emily observe before each doc edit per Principle 18. Commits e937f19, 854d814, 082aab5.
title: S176-01: Prompt-o-verse northstar written and golden-indexed
